name: Alexander Nevsky
role: Grand Prince of Vladimir from 1252 to 1263
contribution: Political and military figure of Kievan Rus' (1246–1263).
legacy: He is considered "one of the great heroes of Russian history", being credited with having "saved the Russian people from Catholicism and being enslaved by the Germans"
image_credit: Collective of Kremlin Armory artists · Public domain

checks.lead: Alexander Yaroslavich Nevsky (Russian: Александр Ярославич Невский; IPA: [ɐlʲɪˈksandr jɪrɐˈsɫavʲɪtɕ ˈnʲɛfskʲɪj] ; monastic name: Aleksiy; 13 May 1221 – 14 November 1263) was Prince of Novgorod (1236–1240; 1241–1256; 1258–1259) and Grand Prince of Vladimir (1252–1263).
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
